stances_toward.note: Dated restatement, not a new claim: Justice Minister Ouahbi and Endowments Minister Toufiq restated Morocco's rights over Ceuta and Melilla in Aug 2026, Spain summoned the Moroccan ambassador and its defence minister rejected any discussion of sovereignty (12 Aug 2026). In the sources found the claim surfaces mainly through ministers' statements, which is why trend is stable and the Spain stance carries the cooling. Bond - grievance: the standing claim over the two enclaves.

relations_to.note: The claim is long-standing; the row is dated by its latest restatement.
